    upper = string.ascii_uppercase

def fix_sentence_spacing(s):
    collapsed = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s).strip()
    lowered = collapsed.lower()
    match = re.search(r'[a-zA-Z]', lowered)
    if not match:

    idx = match.start()
